title: NvironX — DataHacks 2026 Hackathon
description: 1st place for best models trained on Impulse AI. A geospatial intelligence platform that predicts whether a proposed US data center will succeed or fail, scoring community, regulatory, environmental, utility and governance risk, with Claude explaining each score in plain language.

title: Credit Risk Predictor
description: XGBoost credit default model trained on 2M Lending Club loans after removing 60+ data leakage columns (ROC AUC 0.735, 68% default recall). Deployed as a Streamlit dashboard with real-time risk scoring and SHAP explanations.

title: Fantasy Football Draft App
description: Fantasy point projections from a Gradient Boosting model (MAE 0.52) trained on 16,000+ rows of NFL data across 3 seasons, served in a full-stack draft interface with player stats and highlight videos.
